HelpGuideBody:
Choose a preset, then open an image tile to adjust an effect. Each editor keeps its main controls at the top and extra options under More.

Add your own local images, videos and recordings in Library. Press START to run your selected effects. The panic key stops them together while panic is enabled. Close the main window to exit.

Use the topics here or the ? beside an editor title for a demonstration and instructions. Nothing in the guide starts a session.
HelpFlashBody: Flash Images shows selected local pictures and animated GIFs. More controls image count, hold time, motion, GIF speed, click exits and recorded audio linking. Hydra can add replacements within the capacity limit. Gentle visuals softens transitions; Reduced motion holds animation still.
HelpVideoBody: Play selected local videos at normal speed. More controls floating movement, clip length, displays and attention targets. Click targets before they expire; replay and retry limits are configurable. Strict mode blocks individual video closing, while the shared panic policy and main-window exit remain available.
HelpSubBody: Subliminals briefly displays enabled phrases. More lets you edit the phrase pool, font, color, frame duration and whisper volume. Each phrase can use a selected local recording; Classic never creates synthetic speech. Gentle visuals softens the presentation.
HelpSpiralBody: Choose a local GIF or image from the Spiral library, or use a procedural style or saved Loom design. Randomize chooses once at each start without repeating the previous choice when possible. More selects the display and up to two corner GIFs with independent size, position and opacity.
HelpPinkBody: Pink Filter adds a translucent color wash without blocking pointer input. More lets you change its color, place it behind other effects and choose a display. Opacity controls the strength; the filter starts and stops with the session.
HelpBubbleBody: Bubble Pop supports rising, rain and inward spiral motion. More controls size, speed, sound volume and effect bubbles. Pop an effect bubble to request its indicated effect; image bubbles show the same picture used by the flash. Capacity, enabled effects, motion preferences and the shared stop policy still apply.
HelpLockBody: Lock Card asks you to type a selected phrase for the required repetitions. More edits phrases, random repeats or a target character budget, typo resets, paste blocking and colors. Strict mode blocks individual card closing. The shared panic setting applies; closing the main window exits the app.
HelpBounceBody: Bouncing Text moves your enabled phrases across the selected displays. More edits the phrase pool, font, color, second text and animation styles. Wall bounces can earn XP; corner hits count toward achievements in local Progress. Gentle visuals slows movement; Reduced motion holds the text still.
HelpWipeBody: Mind Wipe plays a local recording at the chosen frequency and volume. More lets you choose a recording. Loop starts another after successful playback ends. Failed or interrupted playback does not count as completed. A permitted stop ends playback with the other effects.
HelpDrainBody: Brain Drain has separate audio and visual controls. Audio clip rate sets how often a local clip may play; choose its folders and Refresh in More. Blur strength changes the desktop haze, and zero removes the picture only. Optional melt follows motion preferences. Capture stays in memory; unsupported displays report unavailability.

HelpAudioBody:
Audio controls master and video volumes, local output selection and ducking. Ducking lowers Classic's other recordings while a video or cue plays, then restores them.

Audio layers loops up to eight local recordings together with master and per-track volumes. Opening the editor does not start playback. Audio-only session applies to the next session and skips scheduled visual effects. Companion, corner GIFs, wallpaper and toys keep their own settings.

Classic does not change the volume of other applications. Tutorial animations are silent.
HelpWallBody:
Wallpaper creates a static or moving wallpaper from your selected local images. Choose the mode and adjust its options before starting.

Wallpaper is available on Windows. Classic restores the previous wallpaper when the session ends.
HelpLibraryBody: Add local folders for images, videos and recordings. Use the folder tree to browse and include whole folders; newly added files follow the folder rules. Save named selection presets and load, update or delete them. Open folder shows the original location. Selection changes apply immediately; playing videos finish normally. Source files are never deleted.
HelpCompanionBody: The companion uses the approved Breathe, Relax, Focus, Listen and Deeper recordings. More lets you set its position and size.
HelpToysBody:
Toys connects supported local devices through a localhost provider. Connect the provider and choose intensity and patterns before enabling output.

Audio sync follows decoded sound energy and becomes still during silence, pauses or unavailable analysis. Disconnecting or a permitted stop sends zero output. Device support depends on your local provider.

Enable toy button input and video target answers to use supported Intiface buttons for attention checks. Each press answers one visible target. Button support depends on the device and local provider.
HelpPresetsBody:
A preset recalls a set of effect choices. Choose a built-in card as a starting point, then adjust individual tiles.

Save your current choices as a named local preset. Recalling a preset restores those choices. You can remove your own presets without changing the built-in set.
HelpProgressBody:
Progress records activity locally: session time, completed playback and interactions such as bubble pops and corner hits.

Badge cards show their condition and completion. Interrupted or failed playback does not count as a completed clip. Progress is kept on this computer without an account.
HelpSettingsBody:
Settings contains language, startup behavior, monitor choices, the panic key and visual preferences. Gentle visuals softens effects. Reduced motion holds moving effects still. Performance reduces rendering work.

Learn the panic key before a session. Turning panic off changes every manual stop gesture through the same gate. Closing the main window always exits and releases local playback.

HelpFrequency: How often this effect is scheduled during a session.
HelpSize: Sets the displayed size without changing the source file.
HelpOpacity: Higher values make the effect less transparent.
HelpSpeed: Sets how quickly the visual moves. Motion preferences still apply.
HelpVolume: Sets this sound's volume. Zero is silent.
HelpColor: Choose a color using its six-digit hexadecimal value.
HelpFont: Choose an installed font for this text.
HelpDisplay: Choose which display receives this effect.
HelpEnabled: Includes this item when the session runs.
HelpAudioPick: Choose a local recording. No speech is generated.
HelpAudioClear: Removes this recording link without deleting the file.
HelpPhrase: Edit the words shown by this effect.
HelpAdd: Adds a new entry to this list.
HelpRemove: Removes this entry, leaving source files untouched.
HelpCapacity: Limits how many can be visible at once.
HelpClickDismiss: Click an image to close it using the selected exit effect.
HelpStay: Images remain until clicked instead of expiring on a timer.
HelpLinkAudio: Keeps each image batch linked to its selected recording.
HelpRemix: Sometimes replaces a normal flash with an animated image composition.
HelpHydra: Popping an image can spawn replacements within the screen limit.
HelpHydraTime: Replacement images use the original image's remaining lifetime.
HelpFlashCount: Number of images requested in each flash batch.
HelpRandomCount: Chooses a count between the minimum and the configured count.
HelpMinimumCount: Lowest number used when random count is enabled.
HelpHold: Seconds an image stays visible unless another hold rule applies.
HelpFlashMotion: Choose still images, drifting bounces, swinging motion or a mixture.
HelpGifSpeed: Playback speed of animated images. 1 keeps their original timing.
HelpDrag: Allows dragging and throwing animated images with the pointer.
HelpShatter: Adds a breaking-apart effect when images are dismissed.
HelpGlow: Adds a soft colored glow around the image.
HelpRounded: Softens the image corners without changing the file.
HelpAvoidCenter: Keeps new images away from the center of the screen.
HelpCenterSize: Width of the central area kept clear when avoiding the center.
HelpFade: Time used for the image's fade transition, in milliseconds.
HelpExit: Choose the animation used when an image closes.
HelpStrict: Prevents closing this individual window. The shared panic setting still applies.
HelpFloating: Plays videos in movable windows instead of filling the screen.
HelpAttention: Adds targets to click while a video is playing.
HelpTargetLife: Seconds available to click each target before it counts as missed.
HelpReplay: Repeats the video when an attention target is missed.
HelpMercy: Ends retries after the configured number of failed attempts.
HelpClipMin: Shortest clip length to request, in seconds.
HelpClipMax: Limits playback length. Zero leaves the clip uncut.
HelpRandomStart: Begins partway through the selected video.
HelpTogether: Launches the floating video windows as one batch.
HelpKeepSound: Keeps the current floating video's audio focus when another opens.
HelpBackground: Shows the video with a blurred background fill.
HelpTargetFloating: Shows target words without a background panel.
HelpBorder: Draws a border around each attention target.
HelpDuck: Lowers other Classic recordings while a video or cue plays.
HelpOutput: Choose the local device used for Classic's audio.
HelpTest: Runs a short preview using the current settings.
HelpLoop: Starts the recording again after successful playback ends.
HelpStartup: Opens Classic when you sign in to this computer.
HelpAutoRun: Starts a session automatically when Classic opens.
HelpPanic: Choose the key that stops all effects while panic is enabled.
HelpNoPanic: Disables panic and manual stop gestures. Closing the main window still exits.
HelpReducedMotion: Holds moving effects still instead of animating them.
HelpPerformance: Reduces rendering work to use fewer system resources.
HelpName: Names this local item so you can find it again.
HelpIntensity: Sets the strength sent to the local device, within its limits.
HelpAudioSync: Drives device intensity from the decoded audio. Silence stops the response.
HelpSensitivity: Amplifies quieter audio before converting it into device intensity.
HelpSmoothing: Softens sudden changes in audio-driven intensity.
HelpBass: How much low-frequency sound contributes to audio sync.
HelpRms: How much overall loudness contributes to audio sync.
HelpOnset: How strongly new beats and attacks affect audio sync.
HelpOffset: Shifts the audio response earlier or later, in milliseconds.
HelpBandSplit: Sends bass and higher sounds to separate supported motors.
HelpRole: Chooses which event group this device responds to.
HelpPattern: Chooses the shape of the device pulse.
HelpToyTime: Length of the test pulse, in milliseconds.
HelpSoftRamp: Time taken to rise to a continuous intensity.
HelpTemperament: Changes the character of device responses, from gentle to stronger.
HelpLuminance: Links device intensity to the brightness of flashed images.
HelpScriptVibration: Turns motion from a local FunScript into vibration pulses.
HelpAction: Choose what happens when this rule matches.
HelpRepeat: Number of times the selected phrase must be typed.
HelpTargetLength: Uses a character budget to decide how much typing is required.
HelpVariance: Allows the character target to vary around its configured amount.
HelpTypo: A typing mistake resets progress on the current phrase.
HelpPaste: Requires typing the phrase instead of pasting it.
HelpBehind: Places this overlay behind the other effects.
HelpOverVideo: Allows this text to appear over playing videos.
HelpSecondText: Adds a second independently moving text.
HelpBreathing: Gently grows and shrinks the text in a repeating rhythm.
HelpSpin: Rotates the text while it moves.
HelpLean: Tilts the text toward its travel direction.
HelpSquash: Squashes and stretches the text on a bounce.
HelpCornerBurst: Adds a visual burst when text hits a screen corner.
HelpOutline: Adds an outline to keep text readable over images.
HelpColorMode: Choose a fixed color, random colors or a rainbow cycle.
HelpBlur: Strength of the desktop haze. Zero hides the visual only.
HelpMelt: Animates the captured desktop into a melting distortion.
HelpCapture: Allows the Brain Drain overlay to appear in screenshots.
HelpFolder: Choose a local folder to supply this feature's media.
HelpRefresh: Rescans the available local items without deleting files.
HelpSearch: Filters the library by the words you type.
HelpInclude: Includes this file or folder in the media used during sessions.
HelpFilter: Shows only the selected kind of media.
HelpSelection: Recalls a named set of included local files and folders.
HelpRunFor: Ends the session after the chosen time, or keeps it running until stopped.
HelpAtMinute: Minutes from session start when this preset action runs.
HelpWallpaperRotate: Changes the wallpaper at the chosen interval.
HelpCollage: Combines selected pictures into one wallpaper composition.
HelpPosition: Choose where this item sits on the display.
HelpTopmost: Keeps the companion above other windows.
HelpDetached: Shows the companion in its own movable window.
HelpBarks: Plays approved short local phrases from the companion.
HelpTriggerPhrases: Lets Relax, Focus and Deeper trigger their linked effects.
HelpRandomSpiral: Chooses a spiral at each start, avoiding the previous choice when possible.
HelpReset: Restores the default values for this section.
HelpResetPlacement: Returns the companion to its default position and size.
HelpExport: Saves a local copy of your settings.
HelpStopTest: Stops the current preview or device test.
HelpDurationCap: Maximum video playback time, in minutes.
HelpTargetCount: Number of attention targets requested per video.
HelpPulseCapacity: Limits how many device pulses can overlap.
HelpHighRefresh: Refreshes the desktop blur more often, using more resources.
HelpBarkInterval: Seconds between the companion's recorded phrases.
HelpAllDisplays: Uses every available display instead of only the selected one.
HelpLaunchEffect: Requests this effect when a new session starts.
OptionHelp_LoomArms: Number of spiral arms around the centre.
OptionHelp_LoomTurns: Sets how tightly each spiral arm winds.
OptionHelp_LoomBody: Thickness of the coloured spiral bands.
OptionHelp_LoomStyle: Choose the shape of the spiral arms.
OptionHelp_LoomDirection: Move the pattern inward or outward.
OptionHelp_LoomGradient: Blend adjacent band colours instead of sharp edges.
OptionHelp_LoomRadial: Fade the background from the centre colour to the edge colour.
OptionHelp_LoomSecondLayer: Overlay another spiral with its own shape and colours.
OptionHelp_LoomCycles: Number of repetitions during one animation loop.
OptionHelp_LoomRipples: Number of waves in the spiral distortion.
OptionHelp_LoomHue: Cycles the colours over time. Zero keeps their original hues.
OptionHelp_LoomCenterpiece: Choose a symbol or word to place in the centre.
OptionHelp_LoomFlash: Number of centre pulses per loop. Zero keeps it steady.
OptionHelp_LoomFormat: Choose square, wide or tall proportions for the design.
OptionHelp_LoomPulse: Strength of the repeated expansion and contraction.
OptionHelp_LoomWobble: Strength of the moving wave distortion.
OptionHelp_LoomGlow: Adds a soft glow around the spiral bands.
OptionHelp_LoomColour: Choose a colour with the palette or red, green and blue values.
OptionHelp_LoomRed: Amount of this colour channel, from 0 to 255.
OptionHelp_LoomGreen: Amount of this colour channel, from 0 to 255.
OptionHelp_LoomBlue: Amount of this colour channel, from 0 to 255.
HelpPop: Click a bubble to pop it and collect its reward.
HelpPopSound: Plays the recorded pop sound when a bubble bursts.
HelpEffectBubbles: Allows special bubbles that request an effect when popped.
HelpEffectChance: Percentage of new bubbles that may carry an effect.
HelpEffectType: Chooses the effect requested when a special bubble pops.
HelpBubbleMotion: Choose rising bubbles, falling rain or an inward spiral.
HelpWallpaperMode: Choose a still wallpaper or an animated desktop background.
HelpWhispers: Plays the local recording linked to each displayed phrase.
HelpFrames: How many frames a phrase stays visible. Fewer frames mean a quicker flash.
HelpChooseImage: Choose a local picture without copying or uploading it.
HelpDefaultOutput: Uses the computer's current default audio device.
HelpLayoutSide: Places one large picture beside smaller tiles.
HelpLayoutTiles: Fills the wallpaper with an even grid of pictures.
HelpLayoutCenter: Places one large picture in the center of smaller tiles.
HelpBubbleVariant: Includes this effect in the pool for random effect bubbles.
HelpEventRouting: Chooses which device role receives this event's response.
